items.name: Obeda (generic semaglutide) injection launch, India
items.claim: Dr. Reddy's launched its generic semaglutide injection under the brand Obeda, available in 2 mg and 4 mg strengths in a pre-filled, disposable pen device for once-weekly subcutaneous administration, following DCGI approval as the first Indian company to receive it.
items.source_excerpt: Dr. Reddy’s Obeda® semaglutide injection is available in 2 mg and 4 mg strengths and comes in a pre‐filled, disposable format for subcutaneous, once‐a-week administration with a user-friendly pen device
